# AgentOS

Self-hosted panel running a fixed multi-agent chain (三省六部) on Claude Code / Codex CLIs. One resident program: board/server.py (stdlib HTTP + chain state machine), board/panel.html (responsive UI with live process graph and replay), board/aos.py (CLI client), kernel/ (role workflows, per-step JSON schemas, method skills in Chinese). Human gates: contract approval and change adopt/revert; optional auto mode stops only on censor-found deviations. Start: python3 board/server.py 8765 <projects-root>. Test without tokens: python3 board/tests/test_board.py. Install: python3 scripts/install-agentos.py ~/AgentOS --source . (registers a global `agentos` skill that operates the panel). Docs: README.md, docs/QUICKSTART.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
